Selecting a rheology or suspension ingredient

Teams searching for a natural thickener, bio-based cosmetic ingredient or cosmetic suspension agent need more than a viscosity comparison. Evaluate dispersion, compatibility, sensory properties and stability under relevant conditions. Plant origin alone does not establish safety, regulatory status or finished-product performance.

NeoCell PURE is under development for personal-care-focused evaluation. No universal compatibility, dosage or regulatory approval is implied.

Buyer questions

Can MFC be used in cosmetic formulations?

MFC can be considered for formulation development. A specific ingredient grade and finished product require appropriate safety, regulatory, compatibility and stability assessment before commercial use.

Can MFC help suspend particles?

A suitable fibril network can support suspension, but the outcome must be measured with the actual particles and formulation.

What format does NeoNaar supply?

NeoCell PURE is presented as an aqueous gel / dispersion. Request the current technical data and confirm sample availability, solids content, packaging and storage guidance directly with NeoNaar.
